# Functions

```{r main_fx, eval = F, echo = F}

taxon = 601951

mainfx <- function(taxon){
  
  to_read <- paste0(taxon,"MCP.RData")
  
  for(m in 1:6){
    
    file_to_read <- paste0(scenrios[m],"/",to_read)
    
    if(file.exists(file_to_read)){
      
      load(file_to_read)
      
      # Transform it to same name sppMCPfnl
      # suppressWarnings(
      # if(exists("data")){
      #   spp_data <- as.data.frame(data) %>% 
      #     rowid_to_column("index")
      #   rm(data)
      # }
      
      if(exists("sppMCPfnl")){
        spp_data <- as.data.frame(sppMCPfnl) %>% 
          rowid_to_column("index")
        rm(sppMCPfnl)
      }
      # )
      
      colnames(spp_data) <- c("index",(seq(1951,2100,1)))
      rm(sppMCPfnl) # remove data for computing power
      
      early_data <- spp_data %>% 
        gather("year","value",`1951`:`2100`) %>% 
        mutate(period = ifelse(year < 2014 & year > 1995,"present_1995_2014",
                               ifelse(year < 2039 & year > 2020,"mid_2020_2039",
                                      # ifelse(year < 2100 & year > 2081,"late_2081_2100",
                                      NA))
        ) %>% 
        filter(!is.na(period)) %>% 
        left_join(regional_grid,
                  by = "index",
                  relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
        filter(!is.na(eez_id)) %>%
        group_by(eez_name,year,period) %>% 
        # Sum total catch per eez per year
        summarise(eez_catch = sum(value, na.rm = T),.groups = "drop") %>% 
        group_by(eez_name,period) %>% 
        # Average yearly data
        summarise(mcp = mean(eez_catch,na.rm = T),.groups = "drop") %>% 
        mutate(
          taxon_key = taxon,
          esm = str_sub(file_to_read,79,82),
          ssp = ifelse(str_sub(file_to_read,83,84) == 26,"ssp126","ssp585")
        )
      
      
      # Join data for all three models
      if(m == 1){
        partial_output <- early_data
      }else{
        partial_output <- bind_rows(partial_output,early_data)
      }
      
    }else{
      partial_output
      print(file_to_read)
    }
  }
  
  print(paste(unique(partial_output$esm)))
  
  # Average ESMs +- SD
  final_output <- partial_output %>% 
    group_by(taxon_key,eez_name,period,ssp) %>% 
    summarise(mean_mcp = mean(mcp, na.rm =T),
              sd_mcp = sd(mcp, na.rm =T),
              .groups = "drop") %>% 
    # remove cases where all three periods are 0
    group_by(taxon_key,eez_name,period,ssp) %>% 
    filter(any(mean_mcp != 0))
  
  
  
  name <- paste0(taxon,"_mcp_of.csv")
  print(paste(unique(name)))
  
  write_csv(final_output,
            my_path("R","mcp_nutrition",name))
  
  
} # Close function

```

# Data

```{r}

# Hotspots data
hotspot_data <- my_path("D", name= "hotspots_data.csv", read = T)

# species list
dbem_spp <- my_data("dbem_species")

ran_spp <- list.files(my_path("R","mcp_nutrition"))

ran_spp <- str_sub(ran_spp,1,6)

dbem_spp <- dbem_spp %>% 
  filter(!taxon_key %in% ran_spp)


regional_grid <-
  my_data("sau_index") %>% 
  filter(eez_name %in% hotspot_data$eez_name)

# List esm folders
scenrios <- list.files("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UBC/Data/dbem/dbem_cmip6/r_data",full.names = T)[-3]



```

# Run protocol

```{r}

mainfx(taxon = dbem_spp$taxon_key[1])

mclapply(dbem_spp$taxon_key,mainfx,mc.cores = 10)

```

# Figures 

```{r}

results_path <-
  my_path("R","mcp_nutrition",list_files = "paths")

mcp_nut_df <- bind_rows(
  lapply(results_path, fread)
) %>% 
  left_join(my_data("dbem_species")) %>% 
  select(taxon_key,taxon_name,common_name,name = eez_name,period:sd_mcp)

sau_sf <- my_sf("SAU")

```

```{r}

map_df <- mcp_nut_df %>% 
  # group_by(name,period,ssp) %>% 
  # summarise(
  #   sum_mcp = sum(mean_mcp,na.rm = T)
  # ) %>% 
  filter(
    name == "Ecuador",
    ssp == "ssp585") %>% 
  select(-sd_mcp,-name) %>% 
  spread(period,mean_mcp) %>% 
  mutate(
    per_change = my_chng(present_1995_2014,mid_2020_2039,limit = 50)
  )

map_fig <- sau_sf %>% 
  left_join(map_df) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(per_change))

map <- ggplot(map_fig) +
  my_land_map(fill = "grey70", colo = "grey70") +
  geom_sf(
    aes(
      fill = per_change
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ssp) +
  scale_fill_gradient2("Change in MCP (%)",
                       limits = c(-50,50)
                       ) +
  my_ggtheme_m(leg_width = 2)

ggsave(
  "map.png",
  map,
  width = 10,
  height = 4
)

```
